assessments.reasoning: The instrument does not explicitly inquire about responsibility, performance, or magnitude of unpaid domestic and care work. Regarding responsibility, option 2 of Question 7 ('¿Ama de casa / responsable de los quehaceres del hogar?') serves as a category classifying activity/inactivity status, which does not satisfy the criteria for a direct question asking who is in charge or responsible for domestic/care tasks. Regarding performance, options in Question 14 (option 6), Question 6 (option 11), Question 13a (option 6), and Question 60 (option 6) capture reasons for non-attendance, not seeking work, leaving employment, or not working additional hours; per the specified rules, categories of inactivity or reasons for not working do not count as explicit questions about carrying out domestic/care tasks. Regarding magnitude, the survey contains no questions measuring time or frequency spent on unpaid domestic or care work.
